title: Antiplatelet protocol: Effects of ingesting a tomato pomace extract on human platelet aggregation
author: Concha-Meyer, Fuentes, et al.

steps.title: Prepare orange‑flavoured drinks
steps.instruction: Immediately before ingestion, weigh the required amount of tomato pomace extract and dissolve it in orange‑flavoured water to a final mass of 100 g; prepare a placebo of 100 g orange‑flavoured water.

substeps.instruction: Low‑dose drink: weigh 1 g pomace powder, add orange‑flavoured water and mix to 100 g total.
High‑dose drink: weigh 2.5 g pomace powder, add orange‑flavoured water and mix to 100 g total.
Placebo: measure 100 g orange‑flavoured water (no pomace).

steps.title: Run‑in dietary restriction (Days 1‑14)
steps.instruction: Instruct participants to avoid all foods and beverages that significantly affect platelet activity for 14 days prior to the intervention.

substeps.instruction: Avoid tomato and all tomato‑based products.
Avoid alcohol, cocoa and cocoa‑based products, and green tea.
If a participant self‑prescribes medication for a minor illness, have them contact the research team for assessment and possible rescheduling of the run‑in.

steps.title: Day 15 baseline and acute sampling
steps.instruction: On the morning of day 15, after an overnight fast (no food or drink after 22:00 h the previous night), collect baseline blood, administer the allocated drink, and collect a post‑dose sample 3 h later.

substeps.instruction: Confirm fasting status and ask health‑related screening questions (Annex 2).
Collect a 15 mL fasted blood sample by venepuncture (time = 0 h).
Give the participant the prepared treatment drink (low‑dose, high‑dose, or placebo).
Three hours after ingestion, collect a second 15 mL blood sample.
After the 3‑hour sampling, allow participants to eat and drink ad libitum but remind them to continue avoiding the prohibited foods/beverages listed in the run‑in.

steps.title: Days 16‑18 daily dosing
steps.instruction: Each morning of days 16, 17, and 18, repeat fasting, drink preparation, ingestion, and dietary avoidance.

substeps.instruction: Ensure participants have fasted since 22:00 h the night before.
Prepare the allocated treatment drink fresh (as described in Step 1).
Have the participant ingest the drink on site.
Instruct the participant to continue avoiding tomato products, alcohol, cocoa products, and green tea for the remainder of the study.

steps.title: Day 19 final sampling
steps.instruction: On the morning of day 19, after an overnight fast, repeat health screening, collect a baseline blood sample, administer the drink, and collect a 3‑hour post‑dose sample.

substeps.instruction: Confirm fasting since 22:00 h and complete health questionnaire (Annex 2).
Collect a 15 mL fasted blood sample by venepuncture.
Give the participant the allocated treatment drink.
Three hours later, collect a second 15 mL blood sample.
Conclude the participant’s involvement in the trial.
